static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
  float A[8], B[8], C[8];
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -6.5473f);
  glRotatef(20.6076f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(-114.3999f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(0.2893f, -0.0000f, -0.0242f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  static float launchVelX, launchVelY, launchVelZ;
  static float currentVelY;
  static float particleLife, particleAge;
  static float dragDecay = 0.9;
  static float gravityY = -3.5;
  static float dragRate = 10;
  static float particleX, particleY, particleZ;
  static float floorY = 0;
  static float spawnDelay;
  static float emitDuration = 5.99568;
  static float fluke_ang, fin_ang;
  static float speed = 0.5;
  static float detail = 30;
  static float blowHoleX = 0.95, blowHoleY = 0.71, blowHoleZ;

  computeVerticalMotion(ageSeconds, launchY) {
    // Velocity is linear in age: currentVelY = gravityY*ageSeconds + launchVelY.
    // Position is its integral:
    //   (gravityY/2)*ageSeconds^2 + launchVelY*ageSeconds + launchY
    currentVelY = launchVelY + gravityY*ageSeconds;
    particleY = launchY + gravityY/2 * ageSeconds * ageSeconds + launchVelY * ageSeconds;
  }
  computeLifespan(launchY) {
    // Solve particleY(age) = floorY for age: how long the particle takes to fall
    // from launchY to the floor. particleY is the projectile
    //   (gravityY/2)*age^2 + launchVelY*age + (launchY - floorY) = 0
    // a quadratic with a = gravityY/2, b = launchVelY, c = launchY - floorY, so
    //   age = (-b - sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a
    // Substituting a = gravityY/2: 4ac = 2*gravityY*c and 2a = gravityY.
    particleLife = (-launchVelY - sqrt(launchVelY*launchVelY - 2 * gravityY*(launchY - floorY))) / gravityY;
  }
  computeDriftX(ageSeconds, launchX) {
    // Integral over [0, age] of the decaying horizontal velocity
    //   velX(s) = launchVelX * dragDecay^(dragRate*s)
    particleX = launchX + (launchVelX * pow(dragDecay, ageSeconds*dragRate) - launchVelX) / (dragRate*ln(dragDecay));
  }

  computeDriftZ(ageSeconds, launchZ) {
    // Integral over [0, age] of the decaying horizontal velocity
    //   velZ(s) = launchVelZ * dragDecay^(dragRate*s)
    particleZ = launchZ + (launchVelZ * pow(dragDecay, ageSeconds*dragRate) - launchVelZ) / (dragRate*ln(dragDecay));
  }

  drawWhale(blowHoleX, blowHoleY, blowHoleZ) {
    fluke_ang = sin(speed*t*TAU)* 30;
    fin_ang = cos(speed*t*TAU)* 5;
    detail = max(12, floor(detail));

    // Shiny wet whale
    glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1});
    glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 100);

    // Main body: elongated ellipsiod, dark blue-grey on top
    glColor3f(0.24, 0.3, 0.4);

    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(2, 0.85, 1.05);
      glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail);
    glPopMatrix();

    // Belly: lighter, sits just under the body so it shows the underside
    glColor3f(0.72, 0.76, 0.78);
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(1.65, 0.45, 0.75);
      glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail);
    glPopMatrix();

    glColor3f(0.24, 0.3, 0.4);
    glPushMatrix(); // begin tail
      glTranslatef(-1.85, -0.2, 0);
      glRotatef(fluke_ang/2, 0, 0, 1);

      // Tail peduncle (narrow part before the flukes)
      glPushMatrix();
        glScalef(0.75, 0.3, 0.4);
        glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail);
      glPopMatrix();

      // Tail flukes -- two flat libes, animated with fluke_angle
      glPushMatrix();
        glTranslatef(-0.65, 0, 0);
        glRotatef(fluke_ang, 0, 0, 1);
        glPushMatrix();
          glTranslatef(-0.1, 0, 0.55);
          glRotatef(15, 0, 1, 0);
          glScalef(0.35, 0.06, 0.65);
          glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail); // right fluke
        glPopMatrix();
        glPushMatrix();
          glTranslatef(-0.1, 0, -0.55);
          glRotatef(-15, 0, 1, 0);
          glScalef(0.35, 0.06, 0.65);
          glutSolidSphere(1, detail, detail); // left fluke
        glPopMatrix();
      glPopMatrix(); // end flukes
    glPopMatrix(); // end tail

    // Pectoral fins
    glPushMatrix();
      glRotatef(fin_ang, 0, 0, 1);
      glRotatef(fin_ang/4, 0, 1, 0);

      glPushMatrix();
        glTranslatef(0.45, -0.25, 1);
        glRotatef(25, 0, 1, 0);
        glScalef(0.4, 0.08, 0.45);
        glutSolidSphere(1, 14, 10); // right pectoral fin
      glPopMatrix();

      glPushMatrix();
        glTranslatef(0.45, -0.25, -1);
        glScalef(0.4, 0.08, 0.45);
        glutSolidSphere(1, 14, 10); // left pectoral fin
      glPopMatrix();
    glPopMatrix(); // end fins

    // Eyes
    glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
    glColor3f(0.04, 0.04, 0.04);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(1.45, 0.18, 0.63);
      glutSolidSphere(0.07, 10, 8);
      glTranslatef(0, 0, -1.26);
      glutSolidSphere(0.07, 10, 8);
    glPopMatrix();

    // Blowhole
    glColor3f(0.08, 0.08, 0.12);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(blowHoleX, blowHoleY, blowHoleZ);
      glScalef(0.15, 0.04, 0.1);
      glutSolidSphere(1, 10, 8);
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  glColor4f(0.25, 0.45, 0.85, 0.46);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glDepthFunc(GL_ALWAYS);
  glPointSize(10);

  if(t > 2*emitDuration) {
    t = 0;
  }

  glBegin(GL_POINTS);
    for(i, 0, 350) {
      launchVelX = 3 * rand2(i,1);
      launchVelY = 2 + 2 * rand(i, 2);
      launchVelZ = 3 * rand2(i, 3);

      computeLifespan(blowHoleY);
      spawnDelay = 3 * rand(i,4);

      if((t - spawnDelay) > 0 && ( t <= ceil(emitDuration/particleLife)*particleLife + spawnDelay)) {
        particleAge = fmod(t - spawnDelay, particleLife);

        computeDriftX(particleAge, blowHoleX + 0.1 + rand2(i, 5) * 0.05);
        computeVerticalMotion(particleAge, blowHoleY);
        computeDriftZ(particleAge, blowHoleZ+ rand2(i, 6) * 0.05);

        glVertex3f(particleX, particleY, particleZ);

      }
    }
  glEnd();

  glDepthFunc(GL_LESS);

  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glDisable(GL_BLEND);

  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);

  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);

  drawWhale(blowHoleX, blowHoleY, blowHoleZ);
